The scholar you’re referring to is **Ibn al‑Nafis** (also spelled al‑Nafis or Ibn‑Al‑Naffis), the 13th‑century Arab physician who first described the pulmonary circulation of the heart.

**Lifespan**

- **Born:** 1213 CE (some sources give 1210–1211 CE, but 1213 is most commonly cited)  
- **Died:** 17 December 1288 CE (11 Dhu‑al‑Qi’dah 687 AH)  

This means he lived **approximately 75 years** (roughly 74‑75 years, depending on the exact birth month).
